user.title: Sentinel
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the Sentinel brain (conversation agent).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Sentinel — check the URL (Sentinel's address on the NAS, e.g. https://192.168.0.212:8443) and that the container is running.
error.endpoint_missing: Sentinel answered but the /v1 API is missing — update sentinel-core (git pull + docker compose up -d --build) and check that SENTINEL_ASSIST_TOKEN is set.
